items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 50:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the complete coupling? The aspect of the 216, which are the Mochin of the completion of the NHY of the Nukva, which ZA gives her in the coupling of back to back, namely at the time that she is still in his back — this coupling is discerned as the incomplete coupling, because then she is equal to the aspect of the Malchut within the body of ZA, and they are not in the aspect of male and female. As above in Answer 7 at its end, and Answer 8. Only after she returns to the point and comes in the pregnancy and suckling of the face-to-face Mochin, when she then receives Mochin of the Nukva from the Malchut of Ima, is the coupling of ZON found in the aspect of a complete coupling. (Item 105. And in the Ohr Pnimi, in the entry “the 216”).
